root_cause: Commercial Visa credit transactions are being downgraded to higher-cost consumer pricing tiers due to missing Level 2/Level 3 commercial card data.
diagnosis: The fee deltas (Rs 578.35 and Rs 229.50) indicate that the gateway is applying a higher interchange rate than the expected commercial rate. This is a classic symptom of L2/L3 data leakage, where the absence of specific commercial card fields causes the processor to default to a more expensive consumer or generic interchange tier. Note: This analysis uses a modeled benchmark as the source status is illustrative.
action_rationale: Providing Level 2/3 commercial card data will prevent the gateway from downgrading these transactions to higher-cost consumer interchange tiers.
